evidence.excerpt: We evaluate five classic model families spanning sequence-to-sequence transformers and multilingual encoders; four decoder-only large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA and 4-bit NF4 quantisation; and nine generative models in zero-to-5-shot inference.
